questions.question: Step [14] of the close order, the root. On your last answer push-b769-preroot was made again and the relay's main moved to 0c1b0d1d; the root is computed, ACT ROOT 14ebaf2f over 141 banks, its arm all True, and its banks are not yet committed. One of them, data/b769_act_root.json, carries at :646 the papers' repository's path among the repositories the root covers, and the folder you named in your note at (4)(d) is that path's parent; the note asked that folder kept out of what the act writes. A read of every tracked file of the relay, writing nothing and printing no line, finds the same folder in 7,056 of the 42,209 files read, across 520 acts from b122 on: the same path in b767's and b768's root banks and pins banks, and at this act in eight tracked files beside the ferry's own line, the worklist's constant for the papers' repository and the pins bank committed at the gate among them. The one-call tool's scan reads none of your name, address or ORCID there. Holding the root's json out removes nothing already in the relay, and 13 standing tools read it, the close's among them, so the close stops without it. Which route for the root's banks?

options.label: Commit the root's banks (Recommended)
options.description: The eight paths of b768's root commit under b769's names and data/b769_act_root.json staged by the one-call tool and committed under the root's phase word, as each act's root commit has stood; then the trail, the desk, the suite and the close as ordered. The closing message names the folder's occurrences by count and by path alone, no line printed, this act's nine with the root's json and the relay's 7,056, and carries to b770 a key for the navigator: the papers' repository's parent folder masked in what the act's and the standing tools write.

options.label: Halt the close at the root
options.description: The root's banks left uncommitted in the working tree and steps [14] to [25] carried to the next ruling with this finding; the relay's main stays at 0c1b0d1d and the papers' repository's at 054e1f6e; the rows found after the lock stay in the seat's scratch source and the held banks in the scratchpad for that ruling, and the scores wait with the close.

options.label: Another route
options.description: You name the route in your own words; the close waits at step [14] until then, nothing committed, moved or pushed.
